notes.title: Celebrating One-Inch Tactics 1 Year Anniversary: Pilot Profiles
notes.notes:
To celebrate our the 1 year Anniversary of One-Inch Tactics, let's take a look at the profiles of all 21 pilots from the game!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/5285b25010551d653a36930908ae3a6b25329496.png[/img]
・Kiira Hasti
 Commander. Tall with long blonde hair that is nearly silver colored.
 Military-minded and speaks in a formal fashion. A hidden sentimentalist and a widow.
 "We're commencing the operation. This is our first mission after arriving on the island. Stay alert."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/431306a4642ffdc5395bacf98942696a050c3f1e.png[/img]
・Justyna Berka
 Vice commander, even more serious and military-minded than Kiira.
 Kiira’s sister-in-law, the sister of Kiira’s deceased husband.
 Deeply trusts Kiira and calls her "big sister" in private.
 "Is that the target container? Let's torch it in style."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/4d315f0a865e935ae75331b824d3454c8eea0a0d.png[/img]
・Alicia Forss
 A rigid rookie. Slightly overconfident but generally competent.
 "Deploy and... ambush. I can do this!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/16d278253256482592cd8be0454626881a120de2.png[/img]
・Helena Sewell
 A flashy beauty like a cheerleader.
 Acts as a balancer for the strict commander and vice commander, keeping a cheerful and seemingly superficial demeanor.
 "Breaking things suits me better, though."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/a0cbd1d5f6eb02ace8b9244463dbd249241f2a24.png[/img]
・Elijah Jefferson
 Daughter of military parents, an excellent soldier in both experience and skill.
 Kind-hearted and cares deeply about the team.
 "Securing the firing line is top priority. Everyone, ready?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/974c41323689fc65a917f9c4b15a4f3e0ec5f815.png[/img]
・Corinna Disley
 Slim, tall, and frail.
 Highly skilled in operating Loaders, a hidden ace. Modest and dislikes being in the spotlight.
 "I hope there aren’t any bugs..."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/d84cdc4f2c5cd9ee3417505f2a8c8b0564875cf6.png[/img]
・Frida Vilsmaier
 Rookie. A serious type who takes pride in being a soldier.
 Lacks confidence due to youth and inexperience.
 "Stay calm... Deep breath. Fr-Frida unit, launching!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/12c5c9f6aff347084005d8820f65de485691345f.png[/img]
・Sofiya Nazarova
 A cold, monocle-wearing soldier with a mysterious allure. Heavy drinker, never shows it.
 Oldest in the team, hides bottles in the cockpit.
 "You’re in such a hurry, lengthening your formation like that... heh, perfect targets."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/bba94eb3ffa533b094a5f51c2183ae0dc5f3ef2b.png[/img]
・Luisa Rossellini
 Has the aura of a bakery owner; daughter of a baker. Loves pizza.
 Wears a bandana as her signature look.
 "Destroying supplies... *munch munch*—ah! My hand reached for a snack without thinking..."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/8682eda7c7f103734957984014582475280fcb22.png[/img]
・Laetitia Felix
 One of the twins. Wears hair accessories on the opposite side from her sister.
 Shy but stubborn. Loves her sister openly.
 "Would Rachelle suggest blowing up this bridge too?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/16231e5e31e04f84da72cc5f60d5c2b728ff3fcb.png[/img]
・Rachelle Felix
 The younger of the twins. Wears hair accessories on the opposite side from her sister.
 Tomboyish and pretends to be tough. Loves her sister but keeps it secret—though it's obvious to others.
 "Is it okay if I blow up this bridge?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/7f43efb7b8ad8a79ed0f6d8a2adf90d4a5d5e93f.png[/img]
・Priscila Cruz
 Cheerful fashionista that looks stylish wearing hats. Former athlete.
 Quick to grasp the situation and communicate it to others.
 "Finally regrouped. Alright, if we protect this, it's our team's win."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/fb86e61f627ed6c114179c52d38533e3ba5e34f0.png[/img]
・Johanna Janssen
 Red-haired, freckled, and a mood-maker.
 Often says bold or inappropriate things but somehow gets away with it.
 "Huh? I’m in such an important mission!? Is that okay!?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/b66c6a22da99b3a24393c578e936b58f71650449.png[/img]
・Merve Sari
 Calm and mature. No standout abilities, but highly reliable due to her steady nature.
 "No enemies nearby. Proceeding with careful recon."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/6cfc5aecf4f95f2432ba3ed526171d0b96e884bf.png[/img]
・Astuti Soeharto
 A soldier molded by the commander and vice commander. Loyal to the team and missions. Fearless.
 "Check visibility and concealment status!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/68ad6a3ba3d14afdacbeb7fb5253e602b0011f65.png[/img]
・Loan Pham
 Cheerful but a bit sloppy. Rumored to have been a vice commander in another unit.
 "Ugh, helicopters again? Anyone wanna switch with me...? No? Figured."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/066cef31ab61e9b2424f4905f03552065d28ca29.png[/img]
・Harisha Malik
 Values tradition. A dependable mid-career soldier supporting the team.
 "Let’s hurry. The transport team will arrive soon."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/c93b8ffe093df6787eb89e2cb1d1331ab6e640bf.png[/img]
・Riddhi Barman
 Exotic and progressive. Thinks flexibly and contributes to strategy planning.
 "Got lunch packed? Alright, let’s have a fun little picnic."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/bec651c9af5969a5dbef94324adf609433aacdd6.png[/img]
・Yuxi Liang
 Cute type, wears minimal makeup.
 An innocent genius pilot. Inexperienced but lucky and intuitive.
 "Counterattack time! Let’s beat the bad guys!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/d318f8c58bb446ccfcfabcec901ecc3f24ebccee.png[/img]
・Lianhua Wu
 Elegantly wears makeup.
 Former theater troupe member, speaks in a theatrical manner.
 "Let’s go treasure hunting, shall we?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/662da6eaeec06bc851475ba0ecf218df4098b32d.png[/img]
・Ayano Sakaguchi
 New recruit. Black-haired, petite, and youthful in appearance.
 Born into a prestigious dance family, joined the army out of curiosity for the unknown.
 "Ayano Sakaguchi of the Sakaguchi school, reporting in!"

notes.title: One-Inch Tactics 1.0.4 Update! 10 New Missions!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994506/433d55d5c043ffa5f59b50656c19342899d7e576.jpg[/img]

And for everyone who hasn't yet bought the game, it is currently on sale for 20% off in the KOMODO Holiday Sale!

So set up the virtual table, get out your minis, it's time for even MORE tactical mech action!

notes.title: Update: Korean Language added to One-Inch Tactics!
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders,

It's time to welcome a new group of commanders to the virtual tabletop battlefield with our latest update to One-inch Tactics which adds support for Korean.

We hope that all our current Korean players will enjoy being able to now play in their native language, and that all the new Korean players that can now play the game will enjoy the experience!

notes.title: One-Inch Tactics v1.0.2 Update + Weeklong Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings commanders,

A new update has arrived, and with it, support for Simplified and Traditional Chinese. This will let more players around the world take control of our forces to overcome the enemy with superior tactics! This update also comes with additional gameplay tweaks and bug improvements as listed below.

■ v1.0.2
・Added support for Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
・Overall adjustments were made to anti-air attacks
・Increased the anti-surface attack power of Sniper Rifles
・Estimated damage is now displayed before the start of Close Combat
・Adjustments were made on the difficulty adjustments for Close Combat damage calculations
・Changed the handling of multiple overlapping hex highlighting
・Display switching for the Enemy Search Range has been added to the Settings menu
・If an Enemy or mine is detected, the destination selection now continues (only when Movement Confirmation is OFF)
・Fixed the Enemy Deployment occurring at the beginning of the turn in some missions
・Fixed unexpected messages displaying in some missions
・Fixed the detection of enemies that were out of sight when performing certain maneuvers

Additionally, to celebrate this update, One-Inch Tactics will be on sale for 20% off for the next week!

notes.title: One-inch Tactics now Steam Deck Verified! 20% off through July 29th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're happy to announce that with the upgrades in our latest update (1.01), One-inch Tactics has passed Steam Deck Verification! Now you can play the game on the go without worry.

To celebrate, One-inch Tactics will be 20% off from today through July 29th!

Good hunting out there commander!

notes.title: Update - Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Greetings commanders,

We are pleased to announce that the latest version of One-inch Tactics has landed, bringing with it a host  of bug fixes, quality of life features, and improvements to the UI.

You can find the change-list in the briefing packet below:

・Fix some typos in the text
・Add an option to remove all equipment
・Updated the parameters of some of the trial equipment
・Bigger button icon for pad control
・Bigger font on Steam Deck for some display
・Separate display settings for Steam Deck and PC
・Fix the bottom of the result and supply screen to prevent them from cutting off depending on resolution
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to terminate incorrectly when a high-performance explosive blast was generated outside an area.
・Placement settings are now cleared after batch loading.
・Decoys and chaff can no longer be equipped on indoor maps.
・The effect of stun pods has been changed to "nullifies the first attack from the enemy and reduces the remaining ammunition by 1 when activated".
・The D1 type will no longer hit itself and allies, and will not hit enemies out of sight.
・A simple tag setting has been added to the equipment preset.
・A sort function has been added to the pilot list in the equipment change menu.

As always, thank you for the tactical acumen you are bringing to the field, and good hunting out there.
